# Subra Institute of Fine Arts

> Portrait, painting and drawing classes for kids and adults, Tanjore art, and a Govt-of-India-affiliated diploma for drawing teachers.

Website: https://subrafinearts.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99625 00104

## Contact

## Key facts
- 100 classes in the diploma course
- 12 months: diploma duration

## Facilities
- Diploma in Fine Arts (drawing teacher training)
- Portrait classes
- Drawing classes for kids
- BFA entrance coaching
- Fine art & crafts
- Handwriting
- Fashion design course
- Chess classes
- Aari classes
- Summer camps
- Art supplies store (Selaiyur)

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Subra Institute of Fine Arts?
No. 5, Chitlapakkam Main Road, Nehru Nagar, Chromepet, Chennai 600 044 (Near MIT Bridge).

### What facilities does Subra Institute of Fine Arts have?
Diploma in Fine Arts (drawing teacher training), Portrait classes, Drawing classes for kids, BFA entrance coaching, Fine art & crafts, Handwriting, Fashion design course, Chess classes, Aari classes, Summer camps, Art supplies store (Selaiyur).

### Who can join the diploma?
Anyone 18 or above who has passed 10th standard. It runs 12 months / 100 classes, online or offline.

### Do you teach children?
Yes — drawing classes for kids, handwriting, summer camps and BFA entrance coaching.

### Where are your branches?
Chromepet, Nemilichery, Selaiyur, West Tambaram, Moulivakkam, Thiruvanmiyur, Velachery, Perumbakkam, Kovilambakkam, West Mambalam and Trichy.

### How do I join Subra Institute of Fine Arts?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99625 00104.
